sites.name: Shackleton Crater Rim
sites.notes: One of the sunniest spots on the Moon, on the rim of Shackleton crater. 'Peak near Shackleton' was a NASA candidate landing region in 2022 but is not on the 2024 list; scientists have studied this rim for years. Ice is a short drive down into the crater.

sites.name: Shackleton Crater Floor

power_from.why: Game assumption: solar arrays up on the sunny rim, power sent down a long cable (half lost).

comm_from.why: Game assumption: the crater walls hide Earth, so radio goes through a relay on the rim.

sites.notes: Permanently shadowed: the Sun never reaches the floor, so it is one of the coldest places measured (about -235 C) and can hold ice. Great for water, terrible for solar power. Studied by scientists; not a NASA landing region.

sites.name: Malapert Massif
sites.notes: A 5 km-tall mountain (Mons Malapert) on the Earth-facing side of the pole, so Earth is above the horizon much more often: best for talking to Houston, farther from ice. On NASA's 2024 list of 9 candidate landing regions.
